title: docs(pm-dispatch): an implementation card carries no ADR or skills edits; ADR bookkeeping is filed after the merge

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgSnFirZ8ynCmAemTPrCvXpF)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:派发规则加两行、分诊规则加一行。写代码的卡不再夹带 ADR 或技能文本改动,这类条目各自成为 `domain:skills` 卡;ADR 记账行由落地席在代码合并后立卡并引合并 commit;分诊的 carry note 指向「合并后立卡」。
- 为什么改:裁决记录 6797014134 选 B(原话「32066 C 其他同意」,起因「那skills和adr 就应该单独分拆issue才合理啊」)。此前一行 ADR 记账会把整张代码卡锁到最高模型档,并让代码 PR 等您逐个批准。
- 风险与回滚:纯规则文本,两个文件各自净零行,不新增门禁,不碰冻结的 `dispatch-gates.mjs`,未抬行数上限。为守棘轮,派发规则里两组同主题行合并、分诊规则删一行已在别处成文的「回翻条款」,无规则丢失(见 Acceptance notes)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `references/execution-duties.md` 派发节新增的两行;② 同文件前提过时检查块合并的两处;③ `references/triage-duties.md` 新增的携带注记行与被删的回翻条款行。
- 两分钟验证:跑 `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期 `execution-duties.md is 188 lines (ceiling 188; headroom 0)`、`triage-duties.md is 101 lines (ceiling 101; headroom 0)`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(`check-governed-merges`:Tier S,契约复核 PASS 6812684589 在现 head)。

Fixes #32179

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — internal rules text under `.claude/**`; nothing a metadata author or a customer agent is taught changes

## What changes

Ruling record 6797014134 (letter B), verbatim: "An implementation card's file surface excludes `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `SKILL.md` and `os-dev.md`." / "Those items become their own `domain:skills` cards. The ADR bookkeeping line ("resolved by" or an amended note) is filed by the landing seat after the code merges, citing the merge commit." / "Triage's carry notes point to "file after merge"." / "the landing seat records the owed line at ACCEPT as an Acceptance note with `carrier:`, and files it in the same round."

Net diff against `main`: two files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`, +5 −5, inside the existing ceilings (188/188, 101/101; the ratchet script is untouched).

`execution-duties.md`:

- Added (dispatch section): an implementation card's file surface excludes `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `SKILL.md`, `os-dev.md`; each becomes a `domain:skills` card.
- Added: the ADR bookkeeping line belongs to the landing seat — a `carrier:` note at ACCEPT, a card after the merge in the same round citing the merge commit.
- Paid by two same-subject folds in the premise-staleness block: the 动作面 command joins the staleness line; the "cite the state you read, not the ruling's old description" clause joins the 卡引用面 line. No duty changes.

`triage-duties.md`:

- Replaced the 「回翻条款」 line with: 「ADR/技能文本的携带注记 ⛔ 不挂实施卡:ADR 由落地席合并后立卡,余各立 `domain:skills` 卡。」 The cut rule's homes: `os-dev.md` when-to-stop section, `SKILL.md` escalation section and its no-ruling-for-the-maintainer red line, `seat-post-protocol.md`.

## Tests

Text-only, no executable behaviour. Gates on head `56c19925` (report 6812649188): `dispatch-gates --commands` 19 derived, 19 run, all exit 0, `--ran` 0 unrun; ratchet 188/188 and 101/101; id-lint and `check:skill-frame-sync` clean; `check:commit-card-trailers` exit 0. - Follow-up cards (filed by the seat at ACCEPT): the `AGENTS.md` `packages/services/**` row still puts an ADR status-line edit on the package-creating PR; the spec-property-retirement playbook's published-skills item needs a sequencing rule against the skills-lane split.
- `compile-surfaces.md` is identical to `main` (round 1's consequence edit was reverted with F2).
